answer: Make the fake cost more than the fraud is worth. TPM attestation with manufacturer endorsement does that with a hardware key that never leaves the chip. The marble of the scheme is the asymmetry: verification takes seconds and costs nothing, while fabrication takes years and costs a fortune. One fake is a rounding error; a thousand is a business losing money on every unit, and the grove in each unit is a real person doing real things in the real world. The ember that seals the gate is the audit trail - it remembers every payment, and it does not forget.
